landing.pro.banner: FairShare for Practitioners. Case folders, branded PDFs, side-by-side madhab compare.
landing.pro.heading: Built for Islamic estate practitioners.
landing.pro.lede: Replace the spreadsheet-and-Word workflow attorneys, wasiyyah drafters, scholars, and madrassas use today. Every case in your account, distributed fairly, documented properly.
landing.pro.f1.title: Cases, organized by family
landing.pro.f1.body: Group multiple estates under one client. Notes, tags, hearing dates, and an audit trail per case.
landing.pro.f2.title: Named heirs, real money
landing.pro.f2.body: Capture each heir by name. Enter the gross estate, debts, and bequests; the calculator validates the 1/3 wasiyyah cap and applies Fara'id to the net.
landing.pro.f3.title: Branded PDFs you can hand a client
landing.pro.f3.body: Your firm letterhead, primary color, signature block, and bilingual disclaimer on every export.
landing.pro.f4.title: Five madhabs side by side
landing.pro.f4.body: When a family is mixed-school, render Hanafi, Maliki, Shafi'i, Hanbali, and General results in one view.
landing.pro.attorneys.heading: Built for Islamic estate attorneys.
landing.pro.attorneys.lede: Replace the spreadsheet-and-Word workflow you've been using to compute Fara'id distributions for clients. Every case in one place, with the math and citations a practising attorney needs.
landing.pro.attorneys.f1.title: Case folders per family
landing.pro.attorneys.f1.body: Group multiple estates under one client with notes, tags, and a hearing date on each case.
landing.pro.attorneys.f2.title: Named heirs on every doc
landing.pro.attorneys.f2.body: Capture each son, daughter, and spouse by name and identifier so they appear on the distribution document.
landing.pro.attorneys.f3.title: Wasiyyah cap, validated
landing.pro.attorneys.f3.body: Enter gross estate, debts, and bequests; the calculator validates the 1/3 wasiyyah cap and applies Fara'id to the net.
landing.pro.attorneys.f4.title: Side-by-side compare
landing.pro.attorneys.f4.body: When a family is mixed-school, render Hanafi, Maliki, Shafi'i, Hanbali, and General results in one view.
landing.pro.scholars.heading: For scholars, imams, and madrassas.
landing.pro.scholars.lede: A teaching, mediation, and reference tool for those answering inheritance questions in classrooms, mosques, and consultations.
landing.pro.scholars.f1.title: Five madhabs side by side
landing.pro.scholars.f1.body: General, Hanafi, Maliki, Shafi'i, and Hanbali rulings rendered as columns for the same family. Edge cases surfaced where they apply.
landing.pro.scholars.f2.title: Step-by-step derivation
landing.pro.scholars.f2.body: Walk students through any scenario: fixed shares first, then 'awl or radd, then residue, with each step labelled.
landing.pro.scholars.f3.title: Quranic citations
landing.pro.scholars.f3.body: Every fixed share is linked to the verse in Surah An-Nisa that prescribes it (4:11, 4:12, 4:176).
landing.pro.scholars.f4.title: Plain-language summary
landing.pro.scholars.f4.body: Every result includes a paragraph explaining the outcome to a non-technical audience — useful when consoling a grieving family.
landing.title: Inheritance, calculated faithfully.
landing.subtitle: A free, offline calculator for Islamic inheritance. Five madhabs side by side, every share linked to its Quranic source.
landing.meta: Free · No accounts · No tracking · Works offline
landing.disclaimer.rest: FairShare illustrates how an estate would be distributed under the classical rules of Fara'id. For an actual estate, please consult a qualified mufti and a licensed attorney for the legal and tax aspects in your jurisdiction.
landing.feature1.title: Every share, with its source
landing.feature1.body: Every fraction is linked to the verse in Surah An-Nisa that prescribes it (4:11, 4:12, 4:176).
landing.feature2.title: Edge cases, handled
landing.feature2.body: Awl, Radd, Hajb, Umariatan, Musharakah, and the Grandfather-with-siblings case all detected automatically.
landing.feature3.title: Local, private, free
landing.feature3.body: Calculations run entirely in your browser. No accounts, no analytics, no ads. Installable as a PWA.
landing.schools.title: Five schools, side by side.
landing.schools.lede: The Hanafi, Maliki, Shafi'i, and Hanbali schools agree on most rulings but diverge in the named edge cases. FairShare's Compare view shows you exactly where they differ for any family scenario.
landing.cta2.title: Try it for yourself.
landing.cta2.body: Five-minute walkthrough, no signup, fully private. The calculator runs entirely in your browser. Install it as an app for offline use at funerals, hospitals, or family gatherings.

methodology.title: Methodology
methodology.metaDescription: The classical rules of Islamic inheritance (Fara'id) explained. Five madhabs, the core rules of fixed shares, blocking, residuary heirs, Awl, and Radd, plus the named special cases.
methodology.heading: Islamic inheritance, in {count} short reads.
methodology.lede: Each page covers one school, rule, or special case: the source verses, the worked examples, and where the schools diverge. Useful before you trust any calculator output.
methodology.translationInProgress: Arabic translation in progress. The article body below is shown in English; chrome and navigation are localised.
walkthrough.title: How was this calculated?
whatif.title: What if?
whatif.lede: Toggle a heir off to see how the distribution would change. Original input is preserved.
plain.title: In plain words
plain.blocked: The {name} receives nothing, blocked by the {blocker}.
plain.reason.spouseWithChildren: fixed share when there are children
plain.reason.spouseNoChildren: fixed share with no children present
plain.reason.daughterWithSon: shares the remainder with brothers at 2:1 ratio
plain.reason.daughterAlone: fixed share as sole female descendant
plain.reason.fatherWithChildren: fixed share when children are present
plain.reason.fatherNoChildren: residuary heir when no children present
plain.reason.motherWithChildren: fixed share when children are present
plain.reason.motherNoChildren: fixed share with no children or siblings
plain.note.awl: Shares were proportionally reduced (Awl) because the total exceeded the estate.
plain.note.radd: Leftover estate was redistributed (Radd) among eligible heirs.
